classes.name: WorkUnitLifecycleModule
classes.description: Sekai-owned deep module whose interface owns Work Unit admission and terminal transition replay identity, transition persistence, and durable request deduplication ordering.

classes.name: SekaiGrpcTransportAdapter
classes.description: gRPC adapter that authenticates and authorizes Work Unit callers, maps protocol messages, and delegates durable lifecycle behavior to the Work Unit lifecycle module.

classes.name: WorkUnit
classes.description: Durable coordination record that moves through pending, running, and terminal lifecycle states while holding contention-scope reservations.

relations.name: delegates_work_unit_lifecycle_to
relations.description: The gRPC transport delegates admission replay, lifecycle transitions, persistence, and request deduplication to the Work Unit lifecycle module.

relations.name: governs_work_unit
relations.description: The Work Unit lifecycle module governs durable admission and terminal transitions for Work Units.
